item.title: Hawaiian Electric crews work to restore power throughout Oahu
High surf warning, wind advisory in effect throughout Hawaii
Man, 84, seriously hurt in solo crash on Pali Highway
item.description: An 84-year-old man is in serious condition after a solo crash into an embankment along Pali Highway Sunday evening, according to first responders.

item.title: Gabbard facilitated Trump call to FBI during Georgia election raid
item.description: By any measure, the FBI’s search of an election center in Fulton County, Georgia, last week was extraordinary. Agents seized truckloads of 2020 ballots, as President Donald Trump harnessed the levers of government to not only buttress his false claims of widespread voter fraud, but also to try to build a criminal case against those he believes wronged him.

item.title: California man dies after snorkeling incident on Maui
item.description: A man from California died over the weekend after becoming unresponsive while snorkeling at Makena, according to Maui police.

item.title: Trump: Republicans should ‘nationalize’ voting in 15 locations
item.description: WASHINGTON >> President Donald Trump said today that Republicans should “nationalize” and “take over” voting in at least 15 unspecified places, reiterating his false claims that U.S. elections are marred by widespread fraud.

item.title: Trump threatens to sue Trevor Noah over Epstein joke at Grammys
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> According to President Donald Trump, the 68th Grammy Awards on Sunday were “virtually unwatchable.” Still, he watched enough to take issue with comedian Trevor Noah’s latest turn as the ceremony’s host.

item.title: Gold, silver extend fall as CME margin hikes compound sharp selloff
item.description: Gold and silver prices continued to fall today as higher margin requirements at CME Group compounded last week’s sharp selloff following the nomination of Kevin Warsh as the next Federal Reserve chair.

item.title: SpaceX acquires xAI in record $1.25 trillion ‘Sentient Sun’ merger
item.description: Elon Musk said today that SpaceX has acquired his artificial-intelligence startup xAI in a record-setting deal that unifies Musk’s AI and space ambitions by combining the rocket-and-satellite company with the maker of the Grok chatbot.

item.title: Clintons agree to testify in House Epstein investigation
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Bill and Hillary Clinton agreed on Monday to testify in the House Oversight Committee’s investigation into convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, capitulating to the demands of its Republican chair days before the House was expected to vote to hold them in criminal contempt of Congress.
